sourceSubject: Merged PR 19795: fix: #37883 remove redundant loading of form states in TestSelectionEffects and streamline delete method in TestSelectionService

requirements.behavior: Stop reloading form states after test-selection delete
requirements.rationale: EP remove/remove-multiple effects already end at resetConcludingConversationState without loadFormStates.
requirements.impact: Deleting tests no longer triggers redundant form-state reloads.

requirements.behavior: Parse EpTestSetup DELETE as text response
requirements.rationale: EP TestSelectionService.remove already uses responseType text on /api/sep/EpTestSetup.
requirements.impact: Empty/non-JSON delete responses no longer break the remove observable.
